prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Columbus Ohio for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right choice depends on your location, budget, treatment needs (complex bite problems vs simple alignment), and personal preferences. I can help you find the best fit in Columbus, but first here’s how to identify a top orthodontist and what to ask so you can compare options.

How to choose a top orthodontist
- Look for board certification (American Board of Orthodontics) — that shows advanced training and testing.  
- Prefer a specialist (orthodontist), not a general dentist offering braces.  
- Check Invisalign status (Gold/Platinum/Diamond) if you want clear aligners — higher-tier providers treat more cases.  
- Read recent patient reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades) and look at before/after photos.  
- Confirm experience with cases like yours (adults, teens, complex bite issues).  
- Confirm technology (iTero/3D scanning, digital records, CBCT if needed) and available appliance options (metal, ceramic, lingual, Invisalign).  
- Verify insurance and payment/financing options.

Questions to ask at a consult
- Are you board-certified? How long have you practiced?  
- Have you treated cases like mine? Can I see before/after photos?  
- Are you an Invisalign (or other aligner) provider, and what level?  
- What is the recommended treatment, estimated time, and total fee? What’s included (retainers, monitoring, emergency visits)?  
- How often are visits, and who will do the adjustments?  
- Do you offer payment plans/accept my insurance?  
- What is your policy for broken brackets or emergencies?

Resources to find providers
- American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist” tool  
- Invisalign provider locator (search by city/zip)  
- Google/Yelp/Healthgrades for patient reviews

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated orthodontists in Columbus and list 3–5 with links and quick notes, or  
- Narrow recommendations by neighborhood (e.g., downtown, Polaris, Worthington, Westerville) or by whether you prefer braces vs Invisalign.

Which would you prefer: I search for top-rated offices in a specific Columbus area, or provide a shortlist of practices that are frequently recommended? If so, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood.
